raw_segments.text: Highfalutin stuff. Bladder bags. Ned Lambert is taking a day off I see. Rather upsets a
man's day, a funeral does. He is influenced, they say.
Old Chatterton the vice-gen seller is his grand-uncle or his great-grand-uncle. Close
on ninety, they say. Subleader for his death written this long time perhaps. Living to
spite them. Might go first himself. Johnny, make room for your uncle. The right honorable
hedges air Chatterton. Daresay he writes him an odd, shaky check or two on gale days.
Windfall when he kicks out. Alleluia.
